visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A minimalist black map of Japan is centered on a stark white background. In the bottom right corner, a white cartoon dog character with large pupils and sweat drops on its head appears, looking overwhelmed or shocked. (2) Three cartoon characters—a cat wearing a face mask and glasses, a wide-eyed dog, and a squirrel with glasses—are shown walking together from left to right against a plain white void. They have simple black-line art styles. (3) A wooden mannequin wearing a white dress with black polka dots and a matching capelet appears. The squirrel character approaches the dress with an expression of intense excitement and sparkling eyes. (4) The three characters gather around the mannequin, gesturing wildly with open mouths and dilated pupils, expressing extreme admiration. Stylized yellow sparkles occasionally appear around the dress to emphasize its appeal. (5) Close-up views focus on specific parts of the dress: first the black dots on the fabric, then the rounded collar. A cartoon hand points at these details to highlight them to the viewer. (6) A new character, a dog wearing a collared shirt and vest, appears with a fierce, determined expression and vibrating motion lines, suggesting he is ready to jump into action as a shop clerk. (7) The squirrel character reaches out and picks up a small white paper tag hanging from the mannequin to check the price. (8) A hand-drawn close-up shows the price tag with '40000 ¥' written on it in thick black ink. (9) The squirrel character's face is shown in an extreme close-up, displaying a look of total shock with wide, circular eyes and a speechless expression. (10) The group is seen walking away from the mannequin towards the right, exiting the frame quickly. The dress remains alone on its stand. (11) The original dog character from the first phase reappears, looking thoughtful with one hand on its chin. (12) A different dog character with a smug, knowing smile and narrowed eyes appears, pointing a finger upward as if delivering a punchline.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with an upbeat, rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming along with a light percussion beat. A male narrator begins speaking in a friendly, high-arousal tone at a fast pace. (2) A transition is marked by a bright 'sparkle' chime SFX as the narrator's voice pitches up to mimic excitement while repeating 'so cute.' The background music remains steady. (3) The narrator continues with a dense stream of descriptive speech, maintaining a humorous and slightly exaggerated comedic tone. A subtle 'pop' SFX is heard during a transition between descriptions. (4) A new phase starts when the narrator's volume increases and he uses a more emphatic, dramatic delivery to describe the shop clerk's anticipation. (5) As the characters check the price, a sharp, percussive 'hit' SFX punctuates the moment of realization. The narrator's voice drops slightly in pitch to convey mock seriousness. (6) A short pause in speech is followed by the narrator adopting a dry, sarcastic tone to deliver the conclusion. The upbeat BGM continues through the final reflection before a quick fade-out at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous, anecdotal storytelling format in 2D animation to recount an embarrassing but relatable travel experience. It highlights the contrast between the group's excessive admiration for an expensive garment and their immediate departure once the high price is revealed, poking fun at consumer behavior and the 'poor traveler' stereotype.
